parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air through a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor inside the fan hub.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the stationary housing or frame of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and mounting points.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation.
